description: Use before writing or fixing UMLet XML diagrams for render_diagram (format umlet): XML structure, element ids, required escaping of < > &, relation attributes, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier:
Put the identifier as the first line of the element text and the display name after it, e.g. `<panel_attributes>n0002
engine
--
+rpm: int</panel_attributes>`; UMLet has no separate key, so keep the identifier text exactly as given. Never invent identifiers.

examples.name: interface and implementing class with relation
state and note with colour
